literal_source_claim_en: Asymptotic estimates of number-field class numbers.
statement_blocker: The repository supplies only a family-level gloss. It does not select a sequence or directed family of number fields, normality or other family restrictions, the degree-versus-discriminant condition, class number alone versus the class-number/regulator product, the logarithmic discriminant normalization, the limit/filter, or boundary cases. Choosing a familiar Brauer-Siegel variant at intake would invent or substitute mathematics.
domain_and_universes: Open: the source must select the family or sequence of algebraic number fields, its equality/isomorphism convention, degree and discriminant regime, invariant codomains and coercions, and asymptotic filter.
conclusion: Open: the repository does not choose between a limit, asymptotic equivalence, or bounds, nor whether the subject is class number alone or the class-number/regulator product and how it is normalized by discriminant.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded before a proposition is selected; the statement phase must resolve the rational field, repeated/isomorphic fields, degree one, bounded discriminant, finite or empty families, and logarithmic boundary cases listed in scope-map.md.

a formulation using root discriminant or an equivalent asymptotic relation after a checked transport
